---
title: "Live polls for Quarto revealjs"
subtitle: "Polls and word clouds over a seminar socket.io server"
format:
  revealjs:
    revealjs-plugins:
      - livepoll
filters:
  - livepoll
# Top level, not under `format:`: the filter reads it to configure poll.html.
seminar:
  server: "https://seminar.adamcoates.at/"
  url: "seminar-quarto-demo"   # the venue
  room: "demo"
  # bcrypt hash of the host password. Replace it with your own (see README):
  # with this placeholder the deck renders and runs, but hosting is refused.
  hash: "$2a$05$REPLACE.THIS.WITH.YOUR.OWN.BCRYPT.HASH.SEE.README.."
livepoll:
  layout: embedded             # classic | embedded; per question with layout="..."
---

## Join in

Scan to open the poll page, or press **Shift+Q** for a full-screen QR code.

::: {.poll-qr size="300"}
:::

::: {.notes}
Open the menu (bottom left, or Shift+L), go to the **Live poll** tab, enter
the password and press Start.
:::

## Which language do you use most?

::: {.poll #lang}
- R
- Python
- Julia
- Something else
:::

## What is the capital of Australia?

::: {.poll #capital}
- [ ] Sydney
- [x] Canberra
- [ ] Melbourne
- [ ] Perth
:::

::: {.notes}
Press space to reveal the answer: the correct row turns green, and the phones
show it too.
:::

## Before the reveal

::: {.poll #pvalue results="hidden"}
A p-value of 0.03 means:

- [ ] There is a 3% chance the null hypothesis is true
- [x] Data this extreme would occur 3% of the time if the null were true
- [ ] There is a 97% chance the result is real
:::

## One word for today?

::: {.wordcloud #today max-words="2"}
:::

## How did today go?

::: {.likert #feedback scale="agree-5"}
- The pace of today's lecture was right
- The examples helped
- I could follow the live coding
:::

## How confident are you running a t-test in R?

::: {.likert #confidence scale="0-10" low="Not at all" high="Completely"}
:::

## How was the pace?

::: {.likert #speed labels="Too slow|Just right|Too fast"}
- Pace of today's lecture
:::

## The classic layout

::: {.poll #classic layout="classic"}
Buttons here, the chart on the next slide.

- [x] Looks good
- [ ] Prefer the embedded one
:::

## Classic results

::: {.poll-results for="classic" show-question="true"}
:::

## A classic rating scale

::: {.likert #classic-likert layout="classic" scale="agree-7"}
- The slides were easy to read
- I would use live polls in my own teaching
:::

## How useful was today, from 1 to 5?

::: {.likert #classic-useful layout="classic" scale="1-5" low="Not useful" high="Very useful"}
:::

## Classic rating results

::: {.poll-results for="classic-likert" show-question="true" orientation="vertical" legend="right" color="#444"}
:::

## A classic word cloud

::: {.wordcloud #classic-cloud layout="classic" max-words="1"}
Describe this deck in one word.
:::
